# OpenFX headers

The C headers of the OpenFX image-effect API, version 1.5.1, copied unchanged from the official
repository (https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/openfx, `include/`). They are licensed
under the BSD 3-Clause license in `LICENSE.md`. OfxGrip vendors them so a checkout builds without
a separate SDK install. Update them by copying a newer release's `include/` directory over this one
and recording the version here.
